signal_space_feature_decomposition_autho: only blocks satisfying replicated_prominent_block_rule in heldout_physiological_transfer may enter 169-feature decomposition
all_assigned_sensitivity: repeat point-estimate characterization using all assigned held-out trials/participants; sensitivity cannot satisfy or overturn primary gate
authorization: heldout_physiological_transfer may open only prespecified Validation/Confirmation structural signature and assignment values after verifying physiological_characterization and discovery_physiological_reference_atlas locks

bootstrap.ci: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles using NumPy quantile linear method over finite replicates
bootstrap.sampling: sample eligible participant IDs with replacement within each split; a duplicated participant contributes again; for each family average available sampled participant-family means

contrast_cosine.definition: cosine between fixed Discovery 14D contrast vector and heldout 14D contrast vector

family_centroid: within-participant family mean of all 14 standardized coordinates, then equal-weight mean across participants represented in that family
fingerprint_direction_replication_gate: for BOTH Validation and Confirmation: bootstrap 95% lower CI of contrast cosine > 0 AND point-estimate sign concordance >= 10/14
global_pair: coordinates 12-13 reported separately; never counted as a seventh source block
interpretation: replicated fingerprint means reproducible feature-space geometry only; no emotion semantics, generator localization, causal mechanism, or topographic rescue
non_global_block_contribution: sum of squared heldout contrast coordinates within each prespecified RMS/cosine pair divided by sum over coordinates 0..11
primary_eligibility: participant_eligible == True in each prespecified transfer assignment table
replicated_prominent_block_rule: non-global block contribution > 1/6 in Discovery, Validation, Confirmation AND at least one member coordinate satisfies stable-coordinate rule

sign_concordance.definition: exact sign agreement across all 14 coordinates relative to Discovery

stable_coordinate_rule: same point-estimate contrast sign in Discovery, Validation, Confirmation AND both heldout participant-bootstrap 95% CIs exclude zero in that direction
